name: Mac OS 8
description: Mac OS 8 should have been a completely new system (Project Copland), but due to technical difficulties, Apple settled for a re-brand of MacOS 7.7. However, Apple had created a new design system named "Platinum" for Copland, which allowed theming and came with a new default appearance, reminescent of the classic Macintosh System. This design system made its way into Mac OS 8, so it looked pretty different to Mac OS 7 while essentially being the same base system. For the desktop, Mac OS 8 offered to choose between Patterns and Pictures. In between the Patterns are a hand full of solid colors, including the somewhat iconic default "French Blue (Light)".

colors.name: Gray (Dithered)
colors.note: A solid gray desktop pattern, dithered from a lighter (#a5a5a5) and a darker (#969696) gray in an even 1:1 checkerboard. The two grays are close enough that the conventional pixel average and a linear-light gamma-corrected average both round to this same value.

colors.name: Gray (Light Partial)
colors.note: One of the two grays the dithered gray desktop is mixed from - the lighter shade filling half the checkerboard.

colors.name: Gray (Dark Partial)
colors.note: One of the two grays the dithered gray desktop is mixed from - the darker shade filling the other half.
